Leonidakit rassemble ce que Rockstar a m: Leonidakit brings together what Rockstar has shown of GTA VI, says where each piece of info comes from, and gives you tools to decide: how long a purchase takes, where to go, what to check off.
Avant la sortie, les rumeurs sont partou: Before the release, rumors are everywhere and reliable numbers are nowhere.
Un prix « probable » circule, une carte: A “likely” price is going around, so is a “leaked” map, and you can’t tell anymore what comes from Rockstar. Planning a session with that means counting on a price that doesn’t exist.
Ici, chaque information porte un statut: Here, every piece of info has a status and a dated source. What Rockstar hasn’t published stays “to be confirmed”, prices first. The calculator, the map, progress tracking and Léo then help you decide, with your own numbers.
Chaque outil répond à une question. Tu c: Each tool answers one question. Start wherever you need to.

La carte place les villes, les quartiers: The map shows the cities, neighborhoods and shops seen in the trailers and screenshots. A spotted building isn’t a property you can buy, and the map says so.

Oui, c’est gratuit, et non, il ne faut p: Yes, it’s free, and no, you don’t need an account. Your numbers stay in your browser, on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere else and nothing is linked to your GTA account.
Ce sont les vrais chiffres du jeu ?: Are these the real game numbers?
Pas encore. GTA VI sort le 19 novembre 2: Not yet. GTA VI comes out on November 19, 2026, and Rockstar hasn’t published any prices or mission earnings. The numbers already in the boxes are examples: replace them with yours. As soon as real numbers are known and verified, they’ll be added here, with their source. We never use GTA V or GTA Online numbers instead.
Je ne sais pas combien je gagne par heur: I don’t know how much I earn per hour. What do I do?
Dans « Mon objectif », ouvre « Je ne sai: In “My goal”, open “I don’t know how much I earn”. Enter what your last mission paid you and how many minutes it took. The calculator works out your earnings per hour and puts them in the right box.
C’est une somme que tu ne veux pas dépen: It’s an amount you don’t want to spend, for example to pay for ammo or mission fees. The calculator never touches it: it acts as if that money didn’t exist for your purchases. In “My goal” and the business plan, you also choose what “have” means: money available on top of that amount, money in total (including it), or money earned from now on.
Pourquoi le temps de jeu et le nombre de: Why are play time and the number of days different?
Le temps de jeu, c’est le temps passé à: Play time is the total time you spend playing, for example 8 hours. The number of days depends on how much you play each day: 8 hours of play is 8 days if you play 1 hour per day, but 4 days if you play 2 hours.
Un achat est remboursé quand il t’a rapp: A purchase is paid back when it has earned you as much money as it cost you. Example: you pay $500,000 and it earns you $75,000 per hour, after all fees. It’s paid back after 6 h 40 of play. After that, everything it earns is a bonus.
Comment retrouver mon calcul plus tard ?: How do I find my calculation later?
Donne-lui un nom et clique sur « ☆ Enreg: Give it a name and click “☆ Save”: it goes into “My saved calculations”, on this device. The “My calculations” button, at the top of the workspace, shows them all. “Share” copies a link that reopens the same calculation for a friend. You can also download a file and reopen it on another device.
Non. Le calculateur ne compte que les mi: No. The calculator only counts finished missions, because you get paid at the end. If a mission takes 46 minutes and you have 45 minutes, it doesn’t go into your schedule.
Que montre « Ce qui compte dans ce calcu: What does “What counts in this calculation” show?
Sous chaque réponse, ce bloc dit ce que: Under each answer, this block says what the calculation is looking for and over what period, the required conditions (✓ met, ✗ not met, ? unknown, ≈ your assumption), the numbers used and where they come from, what really decides the answer, what could change it, and the criteria left out with the reason why. A condition that isn’t met is never made up for by a good number elsewhere.
Pourquoi le carburant ou l’entretien son: Why are fuel and maintenance “to be confirmed”?
Rockstar n’a encore rien publié sur le c: Rockstar hasn’t published anything yet about fuel, maintenance, repairs, insurance, resale or ammo in GTA VI. An unknown cost is never counted as 0: it’s marked “to be confirmed”. You can enter your own number or, in Expert mode, choose a simulation you set up yourself; it’s then flagged as a simulation everywhere it counts.
